known as the '''''Theta''-class shuttle''', was a model of [[shuttle]] used by the [[Galactic Republic]] and later, the [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] and [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] ordered [[Grand Vizier]] [[Mas Amedda]] to inform [[Captain]] [[Kagi]] to prepare his ''Theta''-class for immediate takeoff to rescue [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] on [[Mustafar]] following a [[Duel on Mustafar|duel]] there against his former [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The shuttle would also be used to [[transport]] a number of incarcerated Imperial [[senator]]s in the aftermath of a [[Senatorial arrests|mass arrest]] by [[Imperial Intelligence]]. In the early days of the Empire, a ''Theta''-class shuttle transported Sidious and Vader to [[Gattering]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]], and later transported Sidious and Vader to the [[Inquisitorius Headquarters]] in order for Vader to take command of the [[Inquisitorius]]. During the [[Berch Teller campaign]], [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] asked [[Unidentified Imperial captain (Liberator)|the captain]] of the [[Liberator (Venator-class)|''Liberator'']] for a ''Theta''-class for [[transport]] to the ''[[Goliath]]''. ==Characteristics== {{Quote|Would you look at that? An old Theta-class. Don't see many of those in service anymore.''"
"''I prefer the new Sentinel-class myself. More room to stretch out.|A pair of [[Volcanic environment stormtrooper|lava trooper]]s upon seeing a ''Theta''-class on [[Mustafar]]|[[Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle 5|''Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle'' 5]]}} [[File:Theta-class_shuttle.png|thumb|250px|left|Emperor Palpatine's ''Theta''-class shuttle arrives on Mustafar to rescue Darth Vader.]] The ''Theta''-class T-2c [[shuttle]], also referred to as the ''Theta''-class shuttle, was a type of shuttle constructed by [[Cygnus Spaceworks]] on special order by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]], and as such, were never available for public purchase. The shuttle could reach speeds of 2,000 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]], were 18.5 [[meter]]s in length, were equipped with a Class 1 [[hyperdrive]], were outfitted with one [[laser cannon]] and two quad [[laser]] cannons, were crewed by at least two [[pilot]]s, and could accommodate at least four passengers. It had two landing gear [[Limb|legs]] and a ramp that opened up to the front of the ship for entry and exit. The shuttle also carried at least one [[medical capsule]]. The shuttle had two side wings that folded at a degree downward, and raised up in landing position. The shuttle also possessed a central fin, which housed the shuttle's [[ray shield]] generator, with the side wings being able to vent heat collected by the shield. The cockpit of the shuttle was located at the front of the vessel, and had a reinforced window to protect high-level passengers. A second gunner station was located in the cabin. ==Role== The ''Theta''-class primarily served as a [[transport]] for high-ranking individuals, which included the Supreme Chancellor and later [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] Palpatine. The shuttle was also used by the highest ranking [[Imperial officer|officers]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy|navy]]. ==History== During the [[Cloning|Clone]] Wars, Darth Sidious, in his disguise as Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, submitted a special order to Cygnus Spaceworks for the production of the ''Theta''-class shuttle. As a result, the vessel was never available for public purchase. Nearly immediately following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|establishment]] of the Galactic Empire with Darth Sidious as its Emperor and the [[Great Jedi Purge]], Sidious sensed that his newly christened [[Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], was in danger when [[Duel on Mustafar|dueling]] his former [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and ordered [[Grand Vizier]] [[Mas Amedda]] to inform [[Captain]] [[Kagi]] to prepare his ''Theta''-class shuttle for immediate takeoff to Mustafar. Sidious was able to rescue Vader, and brought him to the [[Grand Republic Medical Facility]] on [[Coruscant]] for medical treatment. [[File:AbandonedTower-2017DarthVader6.png|thumb|right|300px|Sidious and Vader travel to the abandoned tower on Coruscant in a ''Theta''-class]] One [[Standard day|day]] after the formation of the Empire, [[Imperial Intelligence]] conducted a [[Senatorial arrests|mass arrest]] of [[senator]]s, resulting in the incarceration of sixty-three senators, and a number of these senators were loaded into a ''Theta''-class shuttle.''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' During the early days of the Empire, Sidious utilized the ''Theta''-class to drop Vader off on [[Gattering]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] so that he could begin his quest to locate a [[kyber crystal]].[[Darth Vader (2017) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 1]] In the early days of the Empire, a ''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle transported Sidious and Vader to the [[Inquisitorius Headquarters]] in order for Vader to take command of the [[Inquisitorius]].[[Darth Vader (2017) 6|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 6]] The shuttle was eventually incorporated into the Imperial Navy, although it would be continuously used by high ranking officers. In [[14 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] to [[14 BBY]]. during the [[Berch Teller campaign]], [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] asked [[Unidentified Imperial captain (Liberator)|the captain]] of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Liberator (Venator-class)|''Liberator'']] for a ''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle for [[transport]] to the ''[[Goliath]]''. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. It was designed as an homage to the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] that first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. The ''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle's tri-wing design was made less angular with a less aggressive cockpit to soften the obviousness of the villain's transport. Though portrayed primarily in CGI in Episode III, the boarding ramp was made as a practical effect and shot against a greenscreen in the scene where Darth Sidious emerges with Darth Vader's charred body on Coruscant.{{DB|starship|thetaclassshuttle|Imperial ''Theta''-class shuttle}} ==Appearances== *''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' {{Ab|Master & Apprentice (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} *[[Darth Vader (2017) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 1]] *[[Darth Vader (2017) 6|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 6]] *[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] {{Ab|Tarkin (audiobook)}} {{1stID|''Theta''-class shuttle}} *[[Target Vader 6|''Target Vader'' 6]] *[[Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle 5|''Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle'' 5]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|38|Helmets}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|62|Databank A-Z}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' {{1stID|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle}} *''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' *''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic, Rebel, and Resistance Starfighters}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Lanzadera T-2c clase Tetha |fr=Navette T-2c de classe Thêta |ja=シータ級T-2cシャトル }} [[Category:Abecederian line]] [[Category:Cygnus Spaceworks products]] [[Category:Starship classes of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Starship classes of the Galactic Republic]]
